Positive edge and pair simplices already impose the common normal fan, so m=2→3 tangency changes without combinatorial fan changes. Independently compared analytic distances and endpoint inequalities for k=3..16 over (a,b)=(1,3),(1,1),(3,1),(1,2),(2,1) and all m cutoffs.
